definition: the equipment you use for taking photographs
description: Over the top of a camera on a tripod, a woman in a striped summer dress stands smiling on a sunlit park lawn under tall trees. Cut to a macro shot of round dew drops beading along a green leaf in a flower bed. Then two hands hold up a black DSLR with a big flash on top and shoot into a sunset over rolling hills, the sun low and orange on the horizon. The same shot holds as the sun drops further. Finally a young man in a straw hat and green shirt turns a big black camera with a long lens towards the viewer at a red-carpet event.
